Scope: next/apps/quiz_app/lib/question_articles.dart + test/question_articles_test.dart, uncommitted working-tree change.

Hashes verified against REPORT.json (docs/rewrite-agents/tasks/READER_A11Y_20261015/REPORT.json), computed independently via sha256sum:
- lib/question_articles.dart: 7ab3ebd36d2689d78706269042bee93fb46115f103984d4de41e4087ad4ecd9e (match)
- test/question_articles_test.dart: 065907054cff45b88ab7b03bd3116250f15ae5aa9c7b60b04358a6f9b98ed8ff (match)

Diff inspected directly: MarkdownBody(selectable: true) replaced by SelectionArea(child: MarkdownBody(...)) with selectable param dropped, onTapLink preserved verbatim. This removes the SelectableText.rich path (which rendered as disabled empty TEXTAREA-equivalent nodes with no accessible text in the AX tree per the report's browser observation) in favor of MarkdownBody's normal Text.rich rendering, with selection supplied by the ancestor SelectionArea instead. This is the documented root cause and the fix directly addresses it — correct, minimal (single widget swap, no logic change), matches the cited flutter_markdown_plus 1.0.12 / SelectionArea official pattern. No dependency, pubspec, question data, or reference changes.

Re-ran independently (not just trusting the report):
- `flutter test test/question_articles_test.dart` -> all 7 tests pass, including the new 'article paragraphs expose readable labels and remain selectable' test (semantics.byLabel finds exactly 1 node, longpress shows Copy menu, no exceptions). Matches report's red/green claim for the current HEAD state.
- `flutter analyze lib/question_articles.dart test/question_articles_test.dart` -> No issues found.
- `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed` on both files -> test file has one reformat-able line (`.articles.single` wrap); cosmetic only, not a correctness or accessibility issue. Non-blocking nit, worth a trivial follow-up formatting pass before commit.

Security: unchanged — https-only source/link validation in QuestionArticle.fromJson and _openArticleSource is untouched by this diff.
Performance: negligible — one extra SelectionArea ancestor widget, no new allocations per rebuild.
Link behavior: onTapLink wiring is unchanged and still passed through to MarkdownBody, so tap-to-open still takes precedence over text selection as before.

Disclosed limitations accepted as stated, not independently re-verified by me: earlier harness mistakes (nearest-semantics-ancestor inspection, a removed test API attempt, delayed handle cleanup) are correctly excluded from the red/green proof; only the final red-tree and green-v3 runs count. I did not run or observe the browser/DTD preview, did not perform any compiled build, and make no claim about Helm58/Reader278 production or the pending compiled967 artifacts — those gates remain explicitly open per the task's own report and are out of scope for this review.

Verdict: source change is ready to land as a source-level accessibility fix. Recommend a trivial dart-format pass on the test file before commit; no other changes requested.
